name: react-locale-datepicker
description: A React date picker that localizes itself from the Intl API — every locale, no locale files, RTL-aware.
COMMENT_exports_styles: A ./styles.css export is deferred until decision D3 (styling strategy) lands. Do not add a styles path that points at nothing.

scripts.test:tz: TZ=UTC vitest run && TZ=America/Los_Angeles vitest run && TZ=Asia/Tokyo vitest run
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test

COMMENT_private: private:true is a deliberate safety catch against an accidental publish. Flip it only at PLAN.md Phase 5, after decision D1 (license) is resolved.
COMMENT_license: No license field until D1 is resolved. Adding one asserts ownership — see docs/DECISIONS.md.
COMMENT_version: 0.0.0 means unreleased. The first published version is 0.1.0.
COMMENT_scripts: typecheck + lint + unit tests are the local gate (npm run check). test:tz re-runs the unit suite under three timezones. test:e2e is the Playwright browser matrix. build uses tsup (D6).
